text:
maya_sales: Heads-up: New medtech prospect asked for commit guidance. POC next Tue. Need capacity plan for 120 req/s sustained (avg 100 tokens), 95th <700ms. Also asked if we can mix reserved V100 + cheaper T4 for overflow.

ash_se: Got it. Quick gutcheck: with open-llama-13b quant on V100 expect ~45-60 req/s/GPU at 100 tokens with properly tuned batching. T4 ~18 req/s. Suggest plan with 20% buffer.

jordan_ops: Proposed calc:
- target = 120 * 1.2 = 144 req/s
- V100 capacity = 55 -> need 3 V100 reserved (3*55=165)
- keep 1-2 T4 for spill and cheaper bursts
- autoscale: min_reserved=3 V100, burst_limit=+2 nodes, cooldown=6m

tess_pricing: Pricing note: hybrid reservations possible; billing order: primary GPU credits first. I can draft committed pricing and show month vs on-demand delta. Also recommend a small burst-credit pool (4h/mo) at discounted rate.

aina_sec: Security asks incoming: encryption-at-rest BYOK, audit logs, and data segregation. We can meet BYOK for Hosted; otherwise propose Redwood Private. I'll start questionnaire draft.

maya_sales: Thanks. I'll book the POC and include a 30m prewarm window. Any objections to 3 V100 + 2 T4 recommendation?

ajordan_ops: No objections. Add runbook items: prewarm script, KV cache priming, and alert: sustained 95th latency >650ms -> trigger scale.

maya_sales: Perfect. I'll update the deal doc and loop legal for the sec requirements.
